name: AuthCard
description: The centered card for sign in, sign up, forgot password and verify code screens: a logo, a title, your form, other ways to sign in and links underneath.

title.description: The screen's title, shown as an h1, e.g. "Sign in to your account".

headingLevel.description: Heading level of the title, 1 to 6.

brand.description: Your logo or name, shown above the title.

children.description: The form: Form, fields and a submit button.

socialProviders.description: Buttons for signing in another way. They are set under an "or continue with" line.

socialLabel.description: The text of the line above the social providers.

footer.description: Links under the card content, such as "Forgot your password?" or "Create an account".

illustration.description: An image or panel for the side of the card. Shown from large screens up; hidden on a phone.

size.description: Width of the form column: 22rem, 26rem or 32rem.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: root, card, brand, header, title, description, body, socialProviders, footer, illustration.

keyboard: Tab: moves through the form fields, the submit button, the providers, then the footer links
requirements: The title is the page's h1
The "or continue with" line is a separator with a text label, read once
The illustration is decorative and hidden from screen readers
The card holds the form only; error summary, labels and messages come from the Form components you put inside
screenReader: "Sign in to your account, heading level 1"

use_when: Sign in, sign up, forgot password, reset password, verify code
avoid_when: A settings form inside the app: use a normal page
anti_patterns: Putting the account's real credentials in examples or tests
Hiding the error summary: a failed submit must be explained

contract.data: Text for the title and description, and the form as children.
customization: brand, footer, socialProviders and illustration slots
the form you pass as children
